# job-agent-kit

> An AI agent workflow kit for Claude Code and Codex that scouts, screens, tracks and drafts for your job search, with your approval for outward actions.

MIT-licensed, version 0.3.0. Python 3.9+ powers the offline tracker. Personal files are local and git-ignored. No auto-apply bots are included. Exact targets and text require approval unless the user has pre-approved the action type. Platform terms still apply. The optional full-access worker is not a technical sandbox.

## Installation
Install the [Claude desktop app](https://claude.ai/download) and open its Code tab, or use Claude Code. Paste:

Install job-agent-kit for me: download https://github.com/LeiZiKang/job-agent-kit to my computer, read its INSTALL.md, and walk me through setup.

中文：

帮我安装 job-agent-kit：把 https://github.com/LeiZiKang/job-agent-kit 下载到本地，读里面的 INSTALL.md，然后一步步帮我配置。

Follow [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/LeiZiKang/job-agent-kit/blob/main/INSTALL.md) in the current session, even when it began outside the kit. Default to ~/job-agent-kit; ask before prerequisite installation or personal-file writes. Use Git, not ZIP, for update support.

## On your Mac
- [English walkthrough](https://leizikang.github.io/job-agent-kit/mac/): Six illustrated scenes from morning triage through scouting, human approval, a local board, Friday review and consent-based updates; fictional demo data.
- [中文场景展示](https://leizikang.github.io/job-agent-kit/zh/mac/): 在 Mac 上从开工到复盘的六个场景，所有记录为假数据，对外动作由用户批准。
- [English walkthrough in Markdown](https://leizikang.github.io/job-agent-kit/mac/index.md): Text version with the exact example funnel and data limitations.
- [中文 Markdown 版](https://leizikang.github.io/job-agent-kit/zh/mac/index.md): 完整文字版，包含示例漏斗与数据缺口说明。
